info.name: RGA - 2D Plane
info.description:
The 4D trivector p^q^r intersects the 3D subspace where w = 1 at the plane determined by the homogeneous points p, q, and r. 

(The z axis is omitted from the figure. Note that the subspace for which w=1 is not planar, but also extends in the z direction)
